achievements.name: Moment of Death
achievements.detail: Use the pocket watch on a corpse and witness the instant that person died.

achievements.name: A Line in the Ledger
achievements.detail: Enter a name and a fate in the book for someone who sailed on the Obra Dinn.

achievements.name: Three Confirmed
achievements.detail: Get three fates right so the book accepts them and completes their portraits.

achievements.name: Chapter Closed
achievements.detail: Correctly settle every fate that belongs to a single chapter of the voyage.

achievements.name: The Captain
achievements.detail: Name the master of the Obra Dinn and record the fate that ended his command.

achievements.name: No Body Aboard
achievements.detail: Correctly record someone who died away from the wreck and left no corpse to examine.

achievements.name: The Mates
achievements.detail: Identify the mates who served under the captain and record each of their fates.

achievements.name: The Passengers
achievements.detail: Record a fate for every traveler who came aboard as a passenger rather than as crew.

achievements.name: Every Scene
achievements.detail: Open each death scene the watch can still reach from the remains on the ship.

achievements.name: The Report
achievements.detail: Leave the wreck and turn the book over to the office that ordered the inspection.

achievements.name: Every Soul
achievements.detail: Give a name and a fate the book will accept for every person who left port on the Obra Dinn.
